svg.aria-label: An incident timeline with four moments: it broke, we noticed, we mitigated, we fixed it. The gap between breaking and noticing is detection time, usually the largest and the only one that can be shortened by work done in advance.
svg.text: THE GAPS ARE WHERE THE INFORMATION IS

g.text: If a customer closed the first gap for you, that is the finding, and the rest of the
postmortem is detail. Understanding why belongs after the site is back up, not before.
